Opened by warehouse-etl-ken on 2026-10-20

Our Python loader reads the first column of every Ledgerline CSV as `\ufeffDate`
instead of `Date`. A hex viewer shows the bytes EF BB BF at the start of the
file. Is that on purpose

file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) is deliberately included by default in CSV exports in src/export/csv.ts. It is meant to help spreadsheet applications recognize the file's UTF-8 encoding when opened directly. The BOM can be disabled via the `bom` option if needed.
